user.title: Casa Mia Sensor Watch
user.description: Add Sensor Watch from the Casa Mia app: the sensors given bands on its Sensor Watch page are watched here, with a status, counts of tasks, warnings, errors and critical, a problem sensor, an event on each change, and a service listing them. Uses the Casa Mia integration's connection to the app.

abort.no_casa_mia: Set up the Casa Mia integration first.

list.name: List
list.description: Every watched sensor at the chosen levels, worst first, then longest standing: its level, value, message and since when. Use it with a response variable, and loop over `sensors` in a template.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: Which levels to list. Leave empty for everything that isn't nominal.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Casa Mia Sensor Watch integration was updated from {from_version} to {to_version}, but Home Assistant is still running {from_version}. Until it restarts, nothing new in {to_version} works. Restart Home Assistant to load it.
